plan.purpose: Predeclared L=128 symmetric Kawasaki benchmark against Majumder and Das (2010), DOI: 10.1103/PhysRevE.81.050102. It checks their reported L=128 time scale and ensemble size with a declared post-processing comparison; it cannot by itself reproduce their multi-size finite-size scaling analysis.
plan.stop_rule: Complete all 40 replicas unless an invariant or storage failure is documented. Do not alter parameters, discard replicas, or extend solely because a fitted slope is inconvenient. Analyse all completed replicas before deciding on any new plan.
